text: This capstone built a real multi-cloud Kubernetes platform for Driftwood Outdoor Apparel: AKS, Terraform for both clouds, a FinOps dashboard, a real incident during the company's biggest sale, and eight more lessons hardening the platform after the fix.

The incident wasn't a detour from the real work — it was the point of it. A multi-AZ cluster and a real FinOps dashboard with per-AZ visibility were built specifically to make a moment like this survivable and diagnosable, and the incident proved exactly that.

This Advanced tier closes out Driftwood's three-tier Cloud Engineer to Cloud Architect capstone path, reaching the full multi-cloud, cross-functional scale a real Cloud Architect's role actually operates at.

A genuinely senior version of this platform would push further still: automated chaos engineering instead of one scheduled drill, true multi-region active-active architecture, and automatic cost-anomaly detection. Naming those honestly, and knowing the real career path from Cloud Engineer to Cloud Architect, is itself part of the job this capstone has been teaching.
